youtube.title: One Quarter Closer
youtube.caption:
If the Moon came a quarter of the way closer, it would look about a third wider, and the tides would already be stronger. A thought experiment.

Closer by a quarter: a third wider, and a stronger pull on the sea.

Part 2 of 8. Full video on YouTube: How Close Can the Moon Get Before It Breaks?

Thought experiment: the Moon is not coming closer. Narration is a synthetic voice (AI); the pictures are AI-assisted paintings and code-rendered.
